name: portfolio-lakehouse-template
description: Generic Databricks lakehouse template for portfolio projects

scripts.deploy: npm run validate && dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle deploy --auto-approve
scripts.redeploy: dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle destroy --auto-approve && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run validate && dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle deploy --target prod --auto-approve
scripts.bootstrap:prod: dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle run setup_pipeline --target prod
scripts.jobs:bronze:prod: dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle run bronze_pipeline --target prod
scripts.jobs:silver:prod: dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle run silver_pipeline --target prod
scripts.jobs:gold:prod: dotenv -e .env -- databricks bundle run gold_pipeline --target prod
scripts.tables:list:bronze: dotenv -e .env -- databricks tables list portfolio_dev bronze --output json
scripts.tables:list:silver: dotenv -e .env -- databricks tables list portfolio_dev silver --output json
scripts.tables:list:gold: dotenv -e .env -- databricks tables list portfolio_dev gold --output json
scripts.test:local: npm run governance:validate && npm run test:refs

author: BeOliveira08
